correctness.rationale: The source radius-of-curvature density is exactly 1-3 eps cos(2t)-8 eps cos(3t), giving strict convexity for |eps|<1/11. The source Steiner centroid vanishes because the support has no first harmonic. The orthoptic is the published alpha=pi/2 isoptic parametrization. Direct differentiation yields the curvature-measure factor 1+(BC'-CB')/(B^2+C^2), and the exact second-order centroid expansion gives coefficient (2,0). Positive curvature of the orthoptic holds for all sufficiently small eps by C2 continuity from the circular case. The packaged symbolic checker replays the trigonometric computation.
